verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows Lovable can be turned INTO an MCP server that other AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude) can call (lovable-docs-8/26) — the opposite direction from this story, which asks whether Lovable itself can consume external MCP servers as a client to gain new tools. No documentation or community evidence shows Lovable connecting to or configuring third-party MCP servers for its own agentic use.
